description: Independent SDK/Wine automatic-mipmap contracts and backend generation formats. Expected facts are independent of generated production predicates.
notes: Backend expanded color storage can generate mips even when the logical D3D format is not an app render target. BC/SNORM/NULL/depth stay single-level for an autogen hint. Volume autogen, DYNAMIC+AUTOGEN, more than one explicit level, SYSTEMMEM/SCRATCH autogen are invalid. NONE is not a valid generation filter. FP32 defaults to POINT without enabled filtering; LINEAR/ANISOTROPIC require bit 0. Normal textures return NONE. Actual GPU tests separately prove the generated paths.
